fields.issue: The ideal stretch-dominated lattice (Ashby 2006 eq 5.1, Gc = Ec/2) is a bound, not a material; strength is not projected because no strut-buckling constant was sourced.
fields.numbers: Passes wrinkling and crimp on the least-factor split from 1.34 (K13D2U-grade), 2.46 (CNT yarn), 4.82 (beryllium), 25.3 (alumina), 55.9 kg/m3 (6061). At 5 kg/m3 a lattice needs 0.378, 0.628 and 0.982 of ideal; measured alumina lattices reach 0.0279 to 0.0422.
fields.closes_when: a lattice of a fibre-grade strut material is built and measured at 1 to 8 kg/m3.
